summary: Full patient-flow E2E for ConsultUro. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed, 2 skipped (informational — /api/inbox and /api/messaging/permissions not routed 200, /api/notifications works). Verified /api/auth/me, /api/bookings/me + POST /api/bookings + cancel + patient scoping (403 on /bookings/all as patient), /api/records/me (no cross-patient leakage), IPSS submit + history, all public content endpoints (announcements, blog, videos, education, guides, diseases, /api/clinics/by-slug/dr-joshi-uro), and DELETE /api/auth/me → grace + POST /api/auth/me/restore round-trip. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, patient token injected via localStorage): /login renders Google + Guest + phone/email OTP; all 29 patient routes tested loaded without endless spinner, red screens or page errors, including /(tabs)/index, /book, /tools, /diseases, /more, /my-bookings, /my-records, /patient-timeline, /ipss (7 questions render + QoL + Save button + history rows), /prostate-volume, /calculators/bmi, /blog, /videos, /education, /guides, /inbox, /notifications, /messaging-permissions, /profile, /refer, /reviews, /help, /about, /about-app, /net-check, /terms, /privacy, /signed-out, /c/dr-joshi-uro. Deletion banner + Cancel wiring confirmed via API round-trip (frontend banner testID='deletion-banner' present per iter28 report). Test patient left restored (pending_deletion=false). BUGS FOUND: (1) HIGH — 4 raw i18n keys rendered on /profile in EN because keys 'profile.rowAppearance', 'profile.rowAppearanceSub', 'profile.rowNetCheck', 'profile.rowNetCheckSub' are missing from src/locales/{en,hi,gu}.ts. Code writes `t('profile.rowAppearance') || 'Appearance'` but t() returns the raw key string (truthy) when the key is missing, so the fallback never fires. Users see literal 'profile.rowAppearance' + 'profile.rowNetCheck' + subs on the Appearance & Connection Diagnostics rows. (2) MEDIUM — On 390px mobile web the app-shell side-drawer (Home/Book/Inbox/…/My Bookings/My Records) is rendered permanently in-flow at ~240px width instead of behind a hamburger, leaving only ~150px for page content. This squeezes /profile so the header card breaks 'Email' and 'patient.test@consulturo.app' into single-character vertical columns; /book header 'Book a Consultation' also wraps oddly. Deprecated packages detected: none new (expo-av not used). RN style-prop warnings still noisy (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) — carried from iter28, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx uses `{t('profile.rowAppearance') || 'Appearance'}` — this pattern is unsafe with the current i18n implementation because `t()` returns the KEY as a string when the key is missing, and that string is truthy, so the JS `||` fallback never triggers. Either add the keys to all locale bundles (preferred) or migrate to `const s = t(k); return s === k ? fallback : s`. Same pattern occurs at profile.tsx:369, 370, 408, 409.

bookings.py create_booking silently persists booking with user_id=null when the caller's phone/email doesn't match the payload. When a signed-in patient books for themselves with a different phone (which the /book form allows), the booking never appears in /bookings/me. Consider defaulting `user_id = user.user_id` for role=='patient' regardless of phone match (with a separate `patient_phone` field for the callback contact).

i18n.tsx `t()` returns the raw key when both the current-lang and English bundles are missing the entry. Consider returning a `[MISSING:key]` marker in dev builds so gaps like the profile row keys are caught by lint/QA before shipping.

rca_of_issue: HIGH bug RCA — /profile raw i18n keys. Repro: (1) localStorage.setItem('session_token','patient_token_1776494002311'); (2) navigate /profile. Observed: 'profile.rowAppearance' and 'profile.rowNetCheck' + their subtitles rendered verbatim on rows 'Appearance' and 'Connection Diagnostics'. Root cause: keys are absent from src/locales/en.ts (and hi.ts, gu.ts). The rendering code `{t('profile.rowAppearance') || 'Appearance'}` relies on t() returning falsy for missing keys, but i18n.tsx returns the key string itself as a last-resort fallback (see i18n.tsx:64-66). That string is truthy, so the || fallback never runs. Mitigation: add the 4 missing keys to all 3 locale bundles (preferred, ~30s edit), or change the fallback pattern to compare against the key.
